mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales ( order_code, status, execute_status, created_date, created_by ) VALUES ( #{sal.orderCode}, #{sal.status}, #{sal.executeStatus}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'SYSTEM' )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sales WHERE created_date < to_timestamp(#{cutoffDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND status = 'ARCHIVED'
